name: codex-profiles
description: Manage multiple OpenAI Codex profiles cleanly across VS Code windows.

commands.title: Codex Profiles: Open Workspace With Profile…

codexProfiles.profiles.description: Custom Codex profiles. The built-in Default profile is resolved from CODEX_HOME or the normal ~/.codex home and is not stored here. Authentication remains owned by Codex inside each CODEX_HOME.

codexProfiles.vscodeCliPath.description: VS Code CLI executable used to open isolated profile windows. Set an absolute path if the 'code' command is not available on PATH.

codexProfiles.vscodeUserDataRoot.description: Root directory for per-profile VS Code user-data directories used to isolate window environments.

codexProfiles.vscodeExtensionsDir.description: Optional shared VS Code extensions directory for isolated profile windows. Empty uses VSCODE_EXTENSIONS or the normal VS Code extensions directory.
